title: MODIS-Aqua R2022 chlorophyll is 16-20% low in March-September 2023 against OLCI, S-NPP and NOAA-20 records, which makes a false 2023 global drop and doubles the MODIS 2003-2023 decline (60S-60N)
abstract: We tested if the NASA MODIS-Aqua R2022 monthly chlorophyll record (ERDDAP science-quality stream, version label R2022.0.3) still has errors from the Aqua orbit drift. We compared it with three records that do not use MODIS-Aqua after 2019: ESA OC-CCI v6.0 (OLCI-A/B only from 2020), NOAA S-NPP VIIRS and NOAA-20 VIIRS. We used 2 x 2 degree box medians of strided 4 km pixels at 60S-60N and compared March-September 2023 with the same months of 2022 and 2024. MODIS-Aqua decreased by 19.8% against OC-CCI (95% tile-bootstrap interval 19.2-20.4%), 16.0% against NOAA-20 and 18.1% against S-NPP. Pairs without MODIS-Aqua changed by -2.2% to +4.5%. The decrease was nearly uniform over all basins and largest in April and September 2023 (about 25%). Thus MODIS-Aqua alone shows global anomalies of -24% in April and -25% in September 2023, where OC-CCI shows -1% and -2%. These months agree with a withdrawn 2024 preprint that reported a 22% global NPP drop in April 2023. The near-real-time MODIS stream had a larger error. With the 2023 months, the MODIS 2003-2023 global trend is -2.6% per decade and 19.5% of the area has a significant decline. Without them, the values are -1.25% and 13.6%; OC-CCI gives -0.45% and 13.2%. No global trend is significant. Since 2024, MODIS-Aqua also has a +10% summer-minus-winter ratio artefact. S-NPP VIIRS chlorophyll drifts by about 20-25% in NOAA and NASA R2018 processing. Limits: no in situ data, Rrs bands not tested, per-file product version not confirmed.

display.caption: Global (60S-60N) monthly chlorophyll anomaly relative to the 2003-2020 mean of each calendar month, on boxes where both products have data. MODIS-Aqua R2022 drops to -24% in April and -25% in September 2023; OC-CCI v6.0 (OLCI only after 2019) does not.

Change of the chlorophyll ratio between product pairs in March-September 2023 relative to March-September 2022 and 2024, for all boxes and for four chlorophyll classes. Bars are 95% intervals from 2,000 bootstrap draws of 20 x 20 degree tiles. Only pairs with MODIS-Aqua show a large decrease.

Global-mean trend from 2003 and ocean area with a significant negative box trend (p < 0.05, AR(1)-adjusted), for MODIS-Aqua, MODIS-Aqua without March-September 2023, and OC-CCI v6.0, for four end years.

citations.reason: Withdrawn preprint that reported a 22% global NPP drop in April 2023 with the steepest drop in September 2023 from 21 years of chlorophyll data; these are the months of largest MODIS-Aqua error found here.
Cael et al. 2023: ocean-colour trends from MODIS-Aqua 2002-2022; its period ends before the 2023 error, and Rrs bands were not tested here.
